sheets.limitations: Experimental color segmentation from 18 sampled native standalone-sheet references, not transcribed or unique units. Candidate lists not exhaustive; hatches/text/water classification approximate. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Scan printed 1958; signed24 April1958, native heading1957; series/catalog 1957. The actual native title is Карта полезных ископаемых СССР: this is its complete geological base, not a mineral occurrence interpretation. Native18-reference legend belongs to THIS sheet, not borrowed. Hatch-only sediment textures and point/mineral/structural symbols are retained in Scan/context, not independently classified. Real pale/yellow/green/blue geological fields retained, no global pale/blue/dark exclusion or coverage fill. Actual native printed scale1:200000. Four labelled corners in assumed Pulkovo1942/Gauss-Kruger zone10 EPSG28410, datum/projection unconfirmed, no independently surveyed/interior landmarks. Native heading/catalog1957, mineral information1 January1957, approval28July1957, signed for printing24April1958. Colors are approximate nonunique/nonexhaustive candidates, not transcribed units or field-grade accuracy.
sheets.accuracy: 4 labelled native frame controls; internal grid-fit RMS 2.17px, leave-one-out max 8.72px. Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
